query: How do I make a BBQ chicken quesadilla?

goal.title: Cook a barbecue chicken and cheese quesadilla
goal.description: Open the tortilla bag and set two tortillas on the board. Retrieve the container of cooked chicken from the microwave. Pour barbecue sauce over one tortilla and spread it with a spoon. Cut chicken pieces smaller and scatter them over the sauce, add shredded cheese and cover with the other tortilla. Cook the filled tortilla stack in a frying pan, repeatedly pressing, checking and turning it with a spatula. Transfer it to a plate and cut it into quarters with a rolling cutter.
goal.final_state: The cooked quesadilla is on the plate, cut into four portions. No eating is shown.
procedure: Lay out two tortillas and retrieve the cooked chicken.
Coat one tortilla with barbecue sauce.
Dice the chicken and add it to the sauced tortilla.
Sprinkle shredded cheese and add the top tortilla.
Cook, press and turn the quesadilla in the frying pan.
Transfer the quesadilla to a plate and cut it into portions.

phases.description: Open the tortilla bag, separate two tortillas onto the board and retrieve the chicken container from the microwave.
Open the sauce bottle and pour a spiral over one tortilla. Fetch a spoon from the drawer and spread the sauce over its surface, then move the chicken container closer.
Briefly use the phone, reposition the tortilla and take chicken from the container. Cut it into small pieces with the knife, then scatter the pieces over the sauce.
Work open the cheese bag, operate the burner and sprinkle cheese over the chicken. Place the second tortilla on top, move the stack into the frying pan and press it flat.
Briefly leave to operate the thermostat, then return and press the tortilla with the palms. Get the spatula, press and lift the edge repeatedly, turn the quesadilla over and press again.
Ready the serving plate, wait, work the spatula beneath the quesadilla and transfer it onto the plate. Put the spatula aside.
Take the rolling cutter and cut the plated quesadilla, briefly turn toward the window, then return to finish crossing cuts and adjust the portions.
